hotspot_eligibility.rule: type == 0; MODIS numeric confidence >= 30; VIIRS confidence n/h (nominal/high).
hotspot_eligibility.note: Presumed vegetation fires include agricultural burning. Sensor confidence classes are quality filters, not comparable calibrated probabilities. Archived processing-version changes remain.

harmonization.reference: Suomi-NPP VIIRS 375 m reported hotspot detections

evaluation.selection_rule: Lower statewide monthly MAE on validation years only.

spatial_check.definition: Train 2013–2020 south of 39.5°N; test 2023–2025 at or north of 39.5°N.

evaluation.coverage_policy: Exclude a paired cell-month from model fitting, validation and test if NASA lists any missing MODIS or Suomi-NPP day in that month. No error-based exclusion; no listed gap does not imply cloud-free exposure.
evaluation.baseline: Month-specific VIIRS/MODIS count ratios estimated only from training years.
evaluation.seasonal: Cell/month VIIRS mean from training years; no MODIS input.

all_reported_months.selection_rule: Lower statewide monthly MAE on validation years only.

spatial_check.definition: Train 2013–2020 south of 39.5°N; test 2023–2025 at or north of 39.5°N.

all_reported_months.coverage_policy: Exclude a paired cell-month from model fitting, validation and test if NASA lists any missing MODIS or Suomi-NPP day in that month. No error-based exclusion; no listed gap does not imply cloud-free exposure.
all_reported_months.baseline: Month-specific VIIRS/MODIS count ratios estimated only from training years.
all_reported_months.seasonal: Cell/month VIIRS mean from training years; no MODIS input.

uncertainty.label: 80% validation-residual band
uncertainty.note: Empirical 2021–2022 residual scale; not a confidence interval or guaranteed coverage. Cell bands must not be summed into a regional interval.

limitations: The reference is a detection/reporting scale, not true fire count or burned area.
Observed VIIRS replaces the modeled series from February 2012 onward; January 2012 was only partly observed.
Historical MODIS-derived values are model backcasts, not actual VIIRS observations; missing small fires cannot be individually reconstructed.
Zero cell counts mean no reports in the archive. Cloud-free exposure and complete orbit sampling are not available from hotspot CSVs alone.
MODIS and VIIRS have different overpass times, sensitivities and geometry; this empirical calibration cannot remove all observational bias.
Models trained after 2012 assume transferable historical relationships; orbit drift and fire-regime changes can violate that assumption.
0.5-degree cells approximate an AOI by their centers; an arbitrary AOI is not an exact clipped-pixel analysis.
Archived MODIS product-version strings change across the record; calibration does not establish a uniformly reprocessed collection.
Independent NASA global-outage metadata masks known-incomplete reference months; it does not measure clouds, local exposure, all partial-day outages or historical platform sampling differences.

coverage.source_columns: Standard Data: Date Missing and Satellite (Sensor); Near Real Time columns excluded
coverage.viirs_startup_note: FIRMS lists Suomi-NPP coverage beginning 20 January 2012. January 1–19 are separately marked preoperational, not attributed to the missing-data table.

supplemental_notices.note: LP DAAC reports a partial-day mission outage and suspended VIIRS processing. This supplementary notice is not a row in the acquired FIRMS Standard Data missing-days table and has not been added to those table-derived day arrays.

limitations: These are all listed historical Standard Data dates for the selected satellites in the table acquired at downloaded_at; the table is not a proof of exhaustive historical outage reporting.
A listed date identifies missing data in the FIRMS database for that satellite/product; it does not establish that every global granule or every California overpass was absent on that date.
A month with no listed dates is not proven complete, cloud-free, or equally observed. Cloud, smoke, view geometry, unlisted/partial outages, and acquisition schedules remain unmeasured by this table.
MODIS missing_days is the union of Terra/Aqua flagged dates. One platform being flagged does not imply both platforms were absent; per-platform arrays and the intersection are supplied separately.
Duplicate rows for a date/platform are collapsed. NOAA-20/NOAA-21 and Near Real Time records are excluded because this snapshot uses standard MODIS and Suomi-NPP data.

Reference availability before Suomi-NPP's start is not represented by zero missing days: viirs_reference_status is not_yet_available before January 2012, and January 2012 has separately documented preoperational days.
Do not convert these day counts into an inverse-coverage scaling factor or corrected hotspot count without a spatial observation model.

lognormal_comparison.note: Approximate two-sided normalized likelihood-ratio test on the same fitted tail; parameters estimated from these data.

exponential_comparison.note: Approximate two-sided normalized likelihood-ratio test on the same fitted tail; parameters estimated from these data.

limitations: Documented final wildfire perimeter area, not satellite hotspot count or precise area actually burned.
The 300-acre floor addresses current CAL FIRE vegetation-dependent size cutoffs; it cannot establish historical completeness.
Missing perimeters, duplicate events, reporting changes, suppression, and regional mixtures can affect the distribution.
A non-small bootstrap p-value is compatibility with a fitted tail, not proof of a power law or self-organized criticality.
Main sample consists of reported perimeter records. Complex parents and children can coexist; see the metadata-based complex sensitivity subset.
extremes.interval_note: alpha_ci: fitted-model semiparametric bootstrap spread; alpha_empirical_ci: empirical record-resampling percentile interval with threshold refitting. Neither accounts for dependence between perimeter records or historical reporting bias.

complex_sensitivity.definition: Exclude records with complex_id or complex_name, names containing COMPLEX, or IRWIN IDs referenced as complex parents. No automatic collapse by shared IRWIN ID.
complex_sensitivity.limitation: A metadata-based sensitivity subset, not a complete event genealogy or guarantee of independence.

perimeters.source: CAL FIRE FRAP California Historic Fire Perimeters, firep25_1
perimeters.area_measure: GIS_ACRES × 0.40468564224; full reported perimeter area, not clipped to AOI
perimeters.geometry: WGS84 GeoJSON; service generalization maxAllowableOffset 0.0005 degrees for display and centroid selection; statistical areas use original GIS_ACRES
perimeters.selection: STATE='CA'; year 2001–2025; positive GIS_ACRES; unique GlobalID. Each record is a reported fire perimeter, not necessarily an independent complex.
limitations: The record is incomplete; missing perimeters, duplicated fires, and generalized geometry are documented by CAL FIRE.
Current reporting criteria: CAL FIRE/contract counties ≥10 acres timber, ≥50 acres brush, ≥300 acres grass, and/or ≥3 impacted structures or ≥1 fatality; cooperating agencies ≥10 acres.
Historical collection criteria can differ; a common tail threshold does not guarantee complete sampling.
Complex and child perimeter records can coexist; explicit complex handling or sensitivity analysis is needed before strong inferential claims.
Full reported perimeter area can include unburned islands and cannot be interpreted as exact burned land area.
Perimeter centroids are for spatial selection; an AOI selects entire events by centroid, not partial clipped areas.

hotspots.source: NASA FIRMS standard-processing annual country archives
hotspots.filter: United States country archive; bbox [-124.5,32.5,-114.1,42.1]; point intersects Census 2020 California state polygon; all confidence and type values retained
limitations: Hotspots are pixel detections, not unique fires or burned area.
Point CSVs do not encode cloud/clear-sky exposure or all missing observations.
VIIRS SNPP begins 20 January 2012; January 2012 is partial.
MODIS Terra-only early record precedes Aqua operational observations in July 2002.
Different spatial sensitivity, acquisition times, and satellite availability require calibration.
All thermal-anomaly types are retained in the prepared CSV; downstream vegetation/quality filters must be documented.
The public MODIS annual archive mixes CSV version values (6.2 before 2018; 6.03 in 2018–2022; 61.03 in 2023–2025); processing changes may influence comparisons.
The VIIRS CSV version value 2 is a collection marker and does not by itself establish the monthly algorithm revision.
